prompts.name: wald-bronze
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished raster GAME HUD FRAME ASSET SHEET for Fragdachse, a woodland arena shooter. Only blank decorative frames, no game screenshot or scene, no words, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no logos. True transparent alpha background outside AND inside the hollow frames. Flat straight-on screen-space UI, parallel horizontal and vertical edges, no perspective. Exactly FOUR separated frame assets arranged in four centered rows on a square canvas with generous transparent spacing: row 1 very wide shallow status frame (aspect 11:1) with two subtle vertical separators dividing three text zones; row 2 medium width capacity frame (aspect 6:1) with a very thin empty progress-track outline along the lower interior; row 3 medium-wide main objective card (aspect 5:1) with room for two lines and a thin empty progress-track outline along lower interior; row 4 same width secondary objective card (aspect 7:1), empty interior. Relative widths row1 90%, row2 58%, row3 and row4 72% of canvas. The four frames form ONE perfectly matching family, same trim widths and corner language. Slim readable borders, decorations only at corners, keep content areas open. Professional hand-painted game interface finish, crisp silhouette, restrained texture. No checkerboard baked in. STYLE: warm aged bronze hairline inlay on dark carved oak, modest olive leaves and tiny moss accents at corner joints. Softly rounded rectangular silhouette, elegant organic woodland craftsmanship. Close to a refined forest fantasy interface, small decorations, absolutely no giant branches or flower wreaths.
